content.short: Derive is an onchain options and futures protocol offering institutional-grade derivatives trading.
content.description: Derive runs options and futures markets on-chain with a portfolio margin system that prices risk across a whole position, not each leg separately. Its v3 API exposes options, perps, lending and vaults, with WebSocket and HTTP endpoints and a documented migration path from v2. Permissionless vaults let anyone create a strategy vault on the venue within minutes.
content.meta: Derive, formerly Lyra, runs onchain options and futures with portfolio margin, a v3 API for options, perps and lending, and permissionless vaults.
